assessments.reasoning: The bound package specification passage identifies public declarations. Physical pages 426–427 expressly make a body required for cursor or subprogram declarations and optional otherwise, and allow body-private declarations.

challenge.method: Compare a public specification that declares only a type in Example 10-2 with the package body requirement and the explicit private-item text.
challenge.results: The body condition is cursor or subprogram declarations. Public visibility, private internals, schema placement and permission to invoke are distinct.

limitations: Public declaration does not imply permission to compile or invoke the item. The scope of grants and database schemas is separate.
